tagline: Short math explainers that actually stick.

videos.title: Two Marbles, No Replacement
videos.subtitle: Straight cut
videos.blurb: Opens on the exam wording and takes it apart phrase by phrase, then shows the bag physically drop from 5 marbles to 4 before any arithmetic happens. Both orders are counted, because both count.

videos.title: Two Marbles, No Replacement
videos.subtitle: Error-first cut
videos.blurb: The same lesson, but it names the wrong answer out loud first. 3/10 is not a random distractor - it is exactly what you get by solving one path correctly and stopping. Running as an A/B against the straight cut.

videos.title: The Butterfly Method
videos.subtitle: Voiceover cut
videos.blurb: Cross-multiplication taught as a butterfly, drawn stroke by stroke on notebook paper. Paced for narration, with a closing note on when the shortcut still needs simplifying.

videos.title: The Butterfly Method
videos.subtitle: Fast cut
videos.blurb: The same lesson at scroll speed. Silent, built to stop a thumb in the first two seconds.

videos.title: Find the Common Denominator
videos.subtitle: Illustrated
videos.blurb: The standard LCD method with exact bar models. One half and three sixths shade to identical widths - the frame that makes equivalence click.

videos.title: Find the Common Denominator
videos.subtitle: Original
videos.blurb: The first cut. Pure code-drawn type and geometry, no illustrations.
